}}'''Walking Adventurer Heads''' are the [[Walking Heads]] of [[Assimilated Adventurer|Assimilated Adventurers]].

==''Spawning''==
* Spawned with a 50% chance when an Assimilated Adventurer dies.
* Spawned by [[Worm|Worms]] through Level 3 [[Scent System|Scents]].
==''Behavior''==
Walking Adventurer Heads are cowardly Melee swarm units.
* Walking Adventurer Heads' Melee Attack is performed through contact damage.
* Walking Adventurer Heads can perform small leaps.
* They will seek out [[Medium Incomplete Form|Medium Incomplete Forms]] to merge with in order to evolve back into Assimilated Adventurers.
* Any Mob within 3 blocks of a Walking Adventurer Head will be inflicted with [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]]. This does not go through walls.
* Walking Adventurer Heads are able to traverse faster in liquids by performing small leaps.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===

* Walking Adventurer Heads, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
* Walking Adventurer Heads will run away during the daytime if no other Parasites are present.
